# Phylum (now Veracode SCA) -- Reference
<!-- Generated By: Claude Code (Claude Opus 4.6) -->

## Overview

Software supply chain security platform specializing in automated behavioral
analysis of open-source packages [60]. Founded 2020. 14 employees. $19.5M
total funding ($15M Series A from ClearSky, May 2022) [63].

## Acquisition

Veracode acquired Phylum technology assets in January 2025 [62][63].

**Post-acquisition changes:**
- Free Community version sunset February 24, 2025 [64]
- Now enterprise-only through Veracode SCA [64]
- Phylum technology integrated into Veracode's SCA offering [62]

## Behavior Analysis Capabilities

Automated analysis across 7 ecosystems: npm, PyPI, RubyGems, NuGet,
Crates.io, Golang, Maven [60].

Detection types:
- Suspicious install scripts
- Network requests to command-and-control servers
- Code obfuscation
- Typosquatting
- Targeted attacks against organizations
- Malware in pre-compiled binaries

## 2024-2025 Trends (Phylum Research)

- Package publication rates increased ~30% in 2024 [61]
- Critical malware detections increased eightfold from 2023 to 2024 [61]
- ~1 in 4 packages published to npm in Q2 2024 were spam [60]

## Veracode SCA (Post-Acquisition)

- Claims 60% more accurate malicious package detection via ML-powered
  behavioral analysis (marketing claim) [62]
- Registry firewall for npm and PyPI [62]
- Reachability analysis to determine if vulnerable functions are actually
  called [62]
